newsitem.title: USA: AmeriCredit stake raised by Regan group.
newsitem.headline: AmeriCredit stake raised by Regan group.

text.p: A group including Regan Partners LP said Monday it raised its stake in AmeriCredit Corp to 2,238,000 common shares or 7.9 percent from 6.5 percent held previously.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said its latest transactions include the purchase of 263,000 additional shares between December 20, 1996 and February 20, 1997 at prices ranging from $16.185 to $20.55 per share.
The purchase of the additional stock was for investment purposes, the group said in the filing.
AmeriCredit Corp is based in Fort Worth, Texas.
